package telegram

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const maximumUpdateBytes = 64 << 10

type updateProcessor interface {
	ProcessUpdate(context.Context, domain.TelegramInboundUpdate) (domain.TelegramInboundResult, error)
}

type Handler struct {
	Secret    string
	Processor updateProcessor
}

func (handler Handler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	provided := r.Header.Get("X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token")
	if handler.Secret == "" || len(provided) != len(handler.Secret) || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(provided), []byte(handler.Secret)) != 1 {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: r.Body, N: maximumUpdateBytes + 1}
	var payload struct {
		UpdateID int64 `json:"update_id"`
		Message  *struct {
			Text string `json:"text"`
			From struct {
				ID    int64 `json:"id"`
				IsBot bool  `json:"is_bot"`
			} `json:"from"`
			Chat struct {
				ID   int64  `json:"id"`
				Type string `json:"type"`
			} `json:"chat"`
		} `json:"message"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil || limited.N == 0 {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid update"})
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid update"})
		return
	}
	if payload.Message == nil || handler.Processor == nil {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"ok": true})
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Processor.ProcessUpdate(r.Context(), domain.TelegramInboundUpdate{
		UpdateID: payload.UpdateID, TelegramUserID: payload.Message.From.ID, ChatID: payload.Message.Chat.ID,
		ChatType: payload.Message.Chat.Type, Text: payload.Message.Text, SenderIsBot: payload.Message.From.IsBot,
	})
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidTelegramUpdate) && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTelegramLinkInvalid) &&
		!errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTelegramLinkConflict) && !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTelegramBindingNotFound) {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, map[string]string{"error": "telegram channel unavailable"})
		return
	}
	if result.ReplyText != "" {
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"method": "sendMessage", "chat_id": payload.Message.Chat.ID, "text": result.ReplyText,
		})
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]bool{"ok": true})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}
